🚀 v1.2.0 — VLyrics 🐇🪽

VLyrics Changelog :

  • Fixed island cannot run idle function when entered to full screen>
  • Bug fixed & Performance improvements>

🚀 v1.3.0 — VLyrics 🐇🪽

VLyrics Changelog :

  • Fixed the island confict with the real notch macs👌
  • Revamped the player controls on expanded island✨
  • Added shuffle and repeat mode button☺️
  • Improved player connectivity for better performance🚀
  • Added slider for seeking the song on expanded view👀
  • Now the window mode is on development, so not shown on menu😎
  • Bug fixed & Performance improvements🚀

🚀 v1.3.1 — VLyrics 🐇🪽

VLyrics Changelog :

  • Fixed the island not auto adjust position when real notch mac detected.👌
  • Added refresh the normal resolution if the app is killed.(only for M1 and later macs)👌

v1.4.0 — VLyrics 🚀👻

VLyrics Changelog :

  • Revamped Window Mode — a resizable, dedicated lyrics window with state driven persistence (size/position/screen), always on top pinning, and native fullscreen support.🔥
  • Added Scrollable fullscreen lyric view with autofollow of the current line on the window mode.🔥
  • Redesigned the Settings window to a native macOS System Settings look.🔥
  • Optimized AppleScript compilation and added performance counters plus polling concurrency control primitives.✨
  • Lyrics candidate selection now filters and ranks by fuzzy score instead of exact title/artist equality, so valid lyrics are no longer dropped when a track's multi artist credit differs between players.
  • Added persistence of user lyric selections and a Clear Storage action for the on device lyrics cache.
  • Consistent lyrics across players — the same song now resolves the same lyrics whether it's playing in Apple Music, Spotify, or Now Playing, even when players report the artist differently.
